address: Camino Hondo, Tariego de Cerrato, 34209, Spain
bio: If you want to eat well and at a reasonable price, head to Casa Chesmy, a restaurant that has been in business for 20 years and is making a name for itself in the Cerrato region in the province of Palencia. Accessed via an attractive tree-shaded garden with an outdoor terrace, the three attractively appointed dining rooms have a rustic feel, one of which features an old kitchen as part of the decor. The traditional, home-style cooking here specialises in farm-reared pigeon and chicken – given that the owner has several dovecots, his own chicken farm, and a market garden that provides Casa Chesmy with many of its vegetables. A tranquil and pleasant experience!...
